about: The one open-pipeline definition. Data-free. workspace-model.cjs (and through it workspace/lib/project.mjs and the browser build) and scripts/gtm_metrics.py read this file; none of them has its own copy of these rules. Change the rule here.
definition: Open pipeline is new-business deals whose HubSpot stage is not closed (the stage's isClosed metadata; hs_is_closed only when the stage is not in the catalog). Stage names never decide closed. On Hold is a separate line, not in the open totals. Renewal, customer-success and partnership pipelines are listed separately and never added in; a deal with no recorded pipeline is not new business. A past close date stays open and is flagged. Weighted = amount x HubSpot stage probability over deals that have both; deals without a probability stay in the open amount and are counted.

closedRule.about: HubSpot isClosed wins. From the export: the deal stage's catalog entry decides (stageMetadataKey); the deal property fallbackDealProperty is read only when the stage is not in the catalog. On a shaped deal, any of dealFlags being true means closed. Stage names never decide it.

fields.about: Where a shaped deal's names come from, first match wins. pipelineId: first non-empty value. stageLabel: first value present (a Sheet override keeps HubSpot's stage in hubspotStageLabel).
